items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: some of them were pupils of Rimsky-Korsakov, so I wanted that; but that didn't last very long.

ctx.x: I studied with Howard Murphy. I got Tootie Camarata to come up there too. That went on for a couple of years and I was so in love with the Russians at that time, there were a lot of immigrants around 180th Street, a whole Russian colony up there at that time, and some of them were pupils of Rimsky-Korsakov, so I wanted that; but that didn't last very long. It wasn't working. So I stopped that.
Then I went back again to Teacher's College and eventually to Bernard Wagner over at Julliard. I didn't matriculate at Julliard, but I studied with this guy privately.
